auditor::Favored Enemy.text: Beginning at 1st level, you have significant experience studying, tracking, hunting, and even talking to a certain type of enemy.

auditor::Marked Target.text: Also at 1st level, you learn to manipulate your nanites to help you mark a target as your favored prey for a time.

auditor::Urban Crawler.text: You are an unsurpassed explorer and survivor, whether it be in the desert wastes or crowded cityscapes. This experience has also made you more capable in dealing with those you meet on your travels. You gain the Hobbyist benefit below, and you gain an additional benefit when you reach 6th level and 10th level in this class.

auditor::Fighting Style.text: At 2nd level, you adopt a particular style of fighting as your specialty. Choose one of the following options. You can't take a Fighting Style option more than once, even if you later get to choose again.

auditor::Techcasting.text: By the time you reach 2nd level, you have learned to make full use of your cultural knowledge to cast techs, much as a shut-in does.

auditor::Auditor Specialization.text: At 3rd level, you choose a specialization to better hunt your prey of choice. Your specialization grants you features at 3rd level and again at 7th, 11th, and 15th level.

auditor::Primal Awareness.text: Beginning at 3rd level, you can use your action and expend one auditor tech slot to focus your awareness on the region around you. For 1 minute per level of the tech slot you expend, you can sense whether the following types of creatures are present within 5 miles of you: A.I., hacked, kaiju, malware, spam, surges, and viruses. This feature doesn’t reveal the creatures’ location or number.

auditor::Wokeness.text: You can focus your awareness through the interconnections of culture: you learn additional techs when you reach certain levels in this class if you don't already know them, as shown in the Wokeness Techs table. These techs don't count against the number of Auditor techs you know.

auditor::Ability Score Improvement.text: When you reach 4th level, and again at 8th, 12th, 16th, and 19th level, you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

auditor::Martial Versatility.text: Whenever you reach a level in this class that grants the Ability Score Improvement feature, you can replace a fighting style you know with another fighting style available to auditors. This replacement represents a shift of focus in your martial practice.

auditor::Extra Attack.text: Beginning at 5th level, you can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

auditor::Careful Step.text: Starting at 8th level, moving through non-teched difficult terrain costs you no extra movement. You can also pass through non-teched plants without being slowed by them and without taking damage from them if they have thorns, spines, or a similar hazard.

auditor::Hide in Plain Sight.text: Starting at 10th level, you can spend 1 minute creating camouflage for yourself. You must have access to scrap metal, trash, dirt, plants, or other naturally occurring materials with which to create your camouflage.

auditor::Blend In.text: Also at 10th level, you make use of newly acquired stealth technology, hiding yourself from view briefly. As a bonus action, you can use tech to become invisible, along with any equipment you are wearing or carrying, until the start of your next turn.

auditor::Vanish.text: Starting at 14th level, you can use the Hide action as a bonus action on your turn. Also, you can't be tracked by non-technological means, unless you choose to leave a trail.

auditor::Enhanced Senses.text: At 18th level, you gain preternatural senses that help you fight creatures you can't see. When you attack a creature you can't see, your inability to see it doesn't impose disadvantage on your attack rolls against it.

auditor::Foe Slayer.text: At 20th level, you become an unparalleled hunter of your enemies. Once on each of your turns, you can add your Wisdom modifier to the attack roll or the damage roll of an attack you make against one of your favored enemies. You can choose to use this feature before or after the roll, but before any effects of the roll are applied.

auditor:dark-stalker::Dark Stalker Tech.text: Starting at 3rd level, you learn an additional tech when you reach certain levels in this class, as shown in the Dark Stalker Tech table. The tech counts as an Auditor tech for you, but it doesn't count against the number of Auditor techs you know.

auditor:dark-stalker::Dread Ambusher.text: At 3rd level, you master the art of the ambush. You can give yourself a bonus to your initiative rolls equal to your Wisdom modifier.

auditor:dark-stalker::Night-Vision Augme.text: At 3rd level, you gain nightvision out to a range of 60 feet. If you already have nightvision from your race, its range increases by 30 feet.

auditor:dark-stalker::Updated Antivirus.text: By 7th level, you have installed new software to resist the mind-altering tech of your prey. You gain proficiency in Wisdom saving throws. If you already have this proficiency, you instead gain proficiency in Intelligence or Charisma saving throws (your choice).

auditor:dark-stalker::Stalker's Flurry.text: At 11th level, you learn to attack with such unexpected speed that you can turn a miss into another strike. Once on each of your turns when you miss with a weapon attack, you can make another weapon attack as part of the same action.

auditor:dark-stalker::Shadowy Dodge.text: Starting at 15th level, you can use your heightened reflexes and vision-obscuring tech to avoid your foe’s attacks. Whenever a creature makes an attack roll against you and doesn't have advantage on the roll, you can use your reaction to impose disadvantage on it. You must use this feature before you know the outcome of the attack roll.

auditor:drone-rigger::Drone Pilot.text: At 3rd level, the bond you become an expert in the minor techs that go into drone repair and maintenance. You learn the quick fix and nanotech twiddling tricks. These are auditor techs for you, but do not count against your number of techs known.

auditor:drone-rigger::Drone Companion.text: At 3rd level, as an action, you can release your drone from its digital form and allow it to take physical shape as a hardlight construct. It appears in an unoccupied space of your choice within 30 feet of you.

auditor:drone-rigger::Improved Drone.text: At 7th level, your constant tinkering and upgrades pay off in significant improvements to your drone. When you summon your drone, it gains a flying speed equal to its walking speed.

auditor:drone-rigger::Drone Blast.text: At 11th level, as an action, you can cause your drone to produce a 30-foot cone of damaging energy. Choose acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison damage (your choice doesn’t have to match your drone’s Surge Resonance). Each creature in the cone must make a Dexterity saving throw against your tech save DC, taking 8d6 damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

auditor:drone-rigger::Ultimate Drone.text: At 15th level, your drone reaches the pinnacle of its power. While your drone is summoned, it gains the following benefits:

auditor:manhunter::Manhunter Tech.text: Starting at 3rd level, you learn an additional tech when you reach certain levels in this class, as shown in the Manhunter Techs table. The tech counts as an Auditor tech for you, but it doesn't count against the number of Auditor techs you know.

auditor:manhunter::Hunter's Sense.text: At 3rd level, you gain the ability to scan a creature and discern how best to hurt it. As an action, choose one creature you can see within 60 feet of you. You immediately learn whether the creature has any damage immunities, resistances, or vulnerabilities and what they are. If the creature is hidden from Observation tech, you sense that it has no damage immunities, resistances, or vulnerabilities.

auditor:manhunter::Hunter's Prey.text: Starting at 3rd level, you can focus your ire on one foe, increasing the harm you inflict on it. As a bonus action, you designate one creature you can see within 60 feet of you as the target of this feature. The first time each turn that you hit that target with a weapon attack, it takes an extra 1d6 damage from the weapon.

auditor:manhunter::Defensive Subsystems.text: At 7th level, you gain extra resilience against your prey’s assaults on your mind and body. Whenever the target of your Hunter’s Prey forces you to make a saving throw and whenever you make an ability check to escape that target's grapple, add 1d6 to your roll.

auditor:manhunter::Reflexive Hack.text: At 11th level, you gain the ability to thwart someone else's tech. When you see a creature using a tech ability or teleporting within 60 feet of you, you can use your reaction to try and foil it. The creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your tech save DC, or its tech or teleport fails and is wasted.

auditor:manhunter::Hunter's Counter.text: At 15th level, you gain the ability to counterattack when your prey tries to sabotage you. If the target of your Hunter’s Prey forces you to make a saving throw, you can use your reaction to make one weapon attack against the quarry. You make this attack immediately before making the saving throw. If the attack hits, your save automatically succeeds, in addition to the attack’s normal effects.

auditor:moderator::Malicious Spam.text: At 3rd level, you modify your weapons to damage a target’s mind with cringe-worthy content. When you hit a creature with a weapon, you can deal an extra 1d4 software damage to the target, which can take this extra damage only once per turn.

auditor:moderator::Moderator Tech.text: Also at 3rd level, you learn an additional tech when you reach certain levels in this class, as shown in the Moderator Tech table. Each tech counts as an Auditor tech for you, but it doesn't count against the number of Auditor techs you know.

auditor:moderator::PR Guru.text: Additionally at 3rd level, your moderating experience gives you exceptional people skills. As a result, whenever you make a Charisma check, you gain a bonus to the check equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of +1).

auditor:moderator::Desensitized.text: Beginning at 7th level, your dealings with guroposters and pornbots has fortified your mind. You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened.

auditor:moderator::Spambot Reinforcement.text: At 11th level, you have learned to manifest the malware festering in your neural net as a hardlight projection: you know the tech Manifest Spam. It doesn't count against the number of Auditor techs you know, and you can cast it without a material component. You can also cast it once without using a tech slot, and you regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest.

auditor:moderator::Server Hopper.text: When you reach 15th level, you can use your connection with the net to become one with the data stream: you can cast digital dash without expending a tech slot. You can do so a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

auditor:monster-coach::Monster Companion.text: At 3rd level, you acquire the companionship of a trained beast, which you can digitally store in your BeastBinder peripheral. The beast is friendly to you and your companions and obeys your commands. Choose its stat block—Aerial Monster, Aquatic Monster, or Ground Monster—which uses your proficiency bonus (PB) in several places. You also determine the kind of creature the monster is, choosing a kind appropriate for the stat block. Whatever kind you choose, the beast is obviously unnatural in some way.

auditor:monster-coach::Exceptional Train.text: Beginning at 7th level, on any of your turns when your beast companion doesn’t attack, you can use a bonus action to command the beast to take the Dash, Disengage, or Help action on its turn. In addition, the beast’s attacks now count as tech for the purpose of overcoming resistance and immunity to mundane attacks and damage.

auditor:monster-coach::Bestial Fury.text: Starting at 11th level, when you command your beast companion to take the Attack action, the beast can make two attacks, or it can take the Multiattack action if it has that action.

auditor:monster-coach::Share Techs.text: Beginning at 15th level, when you cast a tech targeting yourself, you can also affect your beast companion with the tech if the beast is within 30 feet of you.

auditor:mutant-hunter::Hunter's Prey.text: At 3rd level, you gain one of the following features of your choice.

auditor:mutant-hunter::Defensive Tactics.text: At 7th level, you gain one of the following features of your choice.

auditor:mutant-hunter::Multiattack.text: At 11th level, you gain one of the following features of your choice.

auditor:mutant-hunter::Superior Hunter's.text: At 15th level, you gain one of the following features of your choice.

auditor:nanoswarm-host::Gathered Swarm.text: At 3rd level, a swarm of microscopic nanites has bonded itself to you and can assist you in battle. Until you die, the swarm remains in your space, crawling on you or flying and skittering around you within your space. You determine its appearance, or you generate its appearance by rolling on the Swarm Appearance table.

auditor:nanoswarm-host::Nanoswarm Tech.text: Also at 3rd level, you learn the hovering helping hand trick if you don't already know it. When you cast it, the hand takes the form of your Nanite Swarm.

auditor:nanoswarm-host::Mobile Swarm.text: Beginning at 7th level, you can condense part of your swarm into a focused mass that lifts you up. As a bonus action, you gain a flying speed of 10 feet and can hover. This effect lasts for 1 minute or until you are Incapacitated.

auditor:nanoswarm-host::Ravenous Swarm.text: At 11th level, your Gathered Swarm grows mightier in the following ways:

auditor:nanoswarm-host::Nanoswarm Body.text: When you reach 15th level, you can discorporate into your swarm, avoiding danger. When you take damage, you can use your reaction to give yourself resistance to that damage. You vanish into your swarm and then teleport to an unoccupied space that you can see within 30 feet of you, where you reappear with the swarm.

auditor:transmat-driver::Transmaterial T.text: Starting at 3rd level, you learn an additional tech when you reach certain levels in this class, as shown in the Transmaterial Tech table. The tech counts as an Auditor tech for you, but it doesn't count against the number of Auditor techs you know.

auditor:transmat-driver::GateNav.text: At 3rd level, you can perform an area ping with your transmat beacon to locate mysdata hotspots. As an action, you detect the distance and direction to the closest operable, full-scale digitization gate within 1 mile of you.

auditor:transmat-driver::Upload Admin.text: At 3rd level, you can leave tethers of your data in other realms, the conversion of energy as they snap back to you empowering your strikes.

auditor:transmat-driver::Surf the Net.text: At 7th level, you learn to briefly step through the digital realms. As a bonus action on your turn, you can cast the etherealnetwork tech with this feature, without expending a tech slot, but the tech ends at the end of the current turn.

auditor:transmat-driver::Download Admin.text: At 11th level, you gain the ability to project your mysdata from your beacon in a forward download packet. When you use the Attack action, you can transmit up to 10 feet before each attack to an unoccupied space you can see.

auditor:transmat-driver::Signal Interfer.text: At 15th level, your mastery over your transmat beacon allows you to assume a state between digital and physical, interacting with inputs as you so choose to diminish their impact. When you take damage from an attack, you can use your reaction to give yourself resistance to all of that attack's damage this turn.

brawler::Unarmored Defense.text: Beginning at 1st level, while you are wearing no armor and not wielding a shield, your AC equals 10 + your Dexterity modifier + your Wisdom modifier.

brawler::Martial Arts.text: At 1st level, your practice of martial arts gives you mastery of combat styles that use unarmed strikes and brawler weapons, which are any civilian melee weapon and machetes.

brawler::CHI.text: Starting at 2nd level, your training allows you to harness the overclocking ability of your Cerebral Haste Insert (CHI) implant. Your access to this implant is represented by a number of CHI points. Your brawler level determines the number of points you have, as shown in the CHI Points column of the Brawler table.

brawler::Unarmored Movement.text: Starting at 2nd level, your speed increases by 10 feet while you are not wearing armor or wielding a shield. This bonus increases when you reach certain brawler levels, as shown in the Brawler table.

brawler::Weapon Training.text: As you refine your martial arts style, you train yourself to use a variety of weapons as brawler weapons. During a short or long rest, you can briefly practice with a weapon to count it as a brawler weapon until you use this feature again. The chosen weapon must meet these criteria:

brawler::Brawler Clan.text: When you reach 3rd level, you commit yourself to a brawler tradition known as a clan. Your clan grants you features at 3rd level and again at 6th, 11th, and 17th level.

brawler::Deflect Missiles.text: Starting at 3rd level, you can use your reaction to deflect the projectile when you are hit by a ranged attack. When you do so, the damage you take from the attack is reduced by 1d10 + your Dexterity modifier + your brawler level. You can only use this ability against mundane, muscle-powered attacks, such as thrown knives, slingshots, and archery attacks.

brawler::Quick Attack.text: Also at 3rd level, if you spend 1 CHI point or more as part of your action on your turn, you can make one attack with an unarmed strike or a monk weapon as a bonus action before the end of the turn.

brawler::Ability Score Improvement.text: When you reach 4th level, and again at 8th, 12th, 16th, and 19th level, you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

brawler::Slow Fall.text: Beginning at 4th level, you can use your reaction when you fall to reduce any falling damage you take by an amount equal to five times your brawler level, vents embedded in your spine from the CHI implant letting out their exhaust and slowing your descent.

brawler::Fast Healing.text: At 4th level, as an action, you can spend 2 CHI points and roll a Martial Arts die. You regain a number of hit points equal to the number rolled plus your proficiency bonus.

brawler::Extra Attack.text: Beginning at 5th level, you can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

brawler::Stunning Strike.text: Starting at 5th level, you can interfere with the implants and energy flow in an opponent’s body. When you hit another creature with a melee weapon attack, you can spend 1 CHI point to attempt a stunning strike. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be Stunned until the end of your next turn.

brawler::Focused Aim.text: Starting at 5th level, when you miss with an attack roll, you can spend from 1 to 3 CHI points to gain a +2 bonus on the attack roll for each point you spend, potentially turning the miss into a hit.

brawler::Empowered Strikes.text: Starting at 6th level, your unarmed strikes count as tech for the purpose of overcoming resistance and immunity to mundane attacks and damage.

brawler::Evasion.text: At 7th level, your instinctive agility lets you dodge out of the way of certain area effects, such as a grenade’s blast radius. When you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw, and only half damage if you fail.

brawler::Iron Will.text: Starting at 7th level, you can use your action to end one effect on yourself that is causing you to be Charmed or Frightened.

brawler::Parkour.text: At 9th level, you gain the ability to move along vertical surfaces and across liquids on your turn without falling during the move.

brawler::Iron Body.text: At 10th level, your mastery of your own metabolism makes you immune to disease and poison.

brawler::Parry Bullets.text: Starting at 13th level, your ability to deflect missiles is improved, allowing you to also deflect bullets and tech-enhanced projectiles (but not pure tech attacks, like micro seeker). To deflect such high-powered projectiles, you must be armed with a brawler melee weapon.

brawler::Diamond Soul.text: Beginning at 14th level, your mastery of your own body and mind grants you proficiency in all saving throws.

brawler::Perfected Metabolism.text: At 15th level, your implants and training sustain you so that you suffer none of the frailty of old age. You can still die of old age, however. In addition, you no longer need food or water, directly absorbing life-sustaining energy from your CHI implant.

brawler::Ghost in the Machine.text: Beginning at 18th level, you can use your action to spend 4 CHI points to become invisible for 1 minute. During that time, you also have resistance to all damage but kinetic damage.

brawler::CHI Engine.text: At 20th level, when you roll for initiative and have no CHI points remaining, you regain 4 CHI points.

brawler:asura::Arms of the Asura.text: At 3rd level, your mastery of your CHI implant allows you to manifest additional arms made from hardlight and controlled by the implant. As a bonus action, you can spend 1 CHI point to summon forth the arms of the Asura. When you do so, each creature of your choice that you can see within 10 feet of you must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take kinetic damage equal to two rolls of your Martial Arts die.

brawler:asura::Visage of the Asura.text: When you reach 6th level, you can summon the visage of your dissociative self. As a bonus action, or as part of the bonus action you take to activate Arms of the Asura, you can spend 1 CHI point to summon this visage for 10 minutes. It vanishes early if you are Incapacitated or die.

brawler:asura::Body of the Asura.text: Starting at 11th level, when you have both your hardlight arms and visage summoned, you can cause the body of your Asura to appear (no action required). This hardlight body covers your physical form like a suit of armor, connecting with the arms and visage. You determine its appearance.

brawler:asura::Awakened Asura.text: Starting at 17th level, your Asura self is complete, allowing you to unleash its full potential. As a bonus action, you can spend 5 CHI points to summon your Asura and awaken it for 10 minutes. This awakening ends early if you are Incapacitated or die.

brawler:dragon-claw::Draconic Disciple.text: At 3rd level, you learn how to emulate the mythical dragons of ancient legends, using your implants to inflict deadly attacks and your stoic demeanor to overpower others through sheer force of personality. You gain the following benefits:

brawler:dragon-claw::Dragon’s Breath.text: At 3rd level you can channel destructive waves of energy, like those created by the dragons you emulate. When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can replace one of the attacks with an exhalation of draconic energy in either a 20-foot cone or a 30-foot line that is 5 feet wide (your choice). Choose a damage type: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison. Each creature in that area must make a Dexterity saving throw against your CHI save DC, taking damage of the chosen type equal to two rolls of your Martial Arts die on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

brawler:dragon-claw::Wings Unfurled.text: At 6th level when you use your Overclock Rush, you can generate hardlight wings from your back that vanish at the end of your turn. While the wings exist, you have a flying speed equal to your walking speed.

brawler:dragon-claw::Dragon Spirit.text: At 11th level the power of your stoic discipline now radiates from you, warding your allies or inspiring fear in your enemies. As a bonus action, you can create an aura of power that radiates 10 feet from you for 1 minute. For the duration, you gain one of the following effects of your choice:

brawler:dragon-claw::Ascendant Spirit.text: At 17th level, your draconic spirit reaches its peak. You gain the following benefits:

brawler:drunken-fist::Bonus Proficiencie.text: When you choose this tradition at 3rd level, you gain proficiency in the Performance skill if you don’t already have it. Your martial arts technique mixes combat training with the precision of a dancer and the antics of a jester. You also gain proficiency with microbrewer’s tools if you don’t already have it.

brawler:drunken-fist::Drunken Technique.text: At 3rd level, you learn how to twist and turn quickly as part of your Flurry Attack. Whenever you use Flurry Attack, you gain the benefit of the Disengage action, and your walking speed increases by 10 feet until the end of the current turn.

brawler:drunken-fist::Tipsy Sway.text: Starting at 6th level, you can move in sudden, swaying ways. You gain the following benefits.

brawler:drunken-fist::Drunkard's Luck.text: Starting at 11th level, you always seem to get a lucky bounce at the right moment. When you make an ability check, an attack roll, or a saving throw and have disadvantage, you can spend 2 CHI points to cancel the disadvantage for that roll.

brawler:drunken-fist::Intoxicated Frenzy.text: At 17th level, you gain the ability to make an overwhelming number of attacks against a group of enemies. When you use your Flurry Attack, you can make up to three additional attacks with it (up to a total of five additional attacks), provided that each Flurry Attack targets a different creature this turn.

brawler:kung-fu::Open Hand Technique.text: Starting when you choose this tradition at 3rd level, you can manipulate your enemy’s life force when you harness your CHI implant’s energy. Whenever you hit a creature with one of the attacks granted by your Flurry Attack, you can impose one of the following effects on that target:

brawler:kung-fu::Rapid Regeneration.text: At 6th level, you gain the ability to heal yourself by infusing your blood with nanites released from your CHI implant. As an action, you can regain hit points equal to three times your brawler level. You must finish a long rest before you can use this feature again.

brawler:kung-fu::Technical Pacifist.text: Beginning at 11th level, you can enter a special meditation that disrupts the violent impulses of those around you. At the end of a long rest, you gain the effect of a target disruptor spell that lasts until the start of your next long rest (the spell can end early as normal). The saving throw DC for the spell equals 8 + your Wisdom modifier + your proficiency bonus.

brawler:kung-fu::Kill Switch.text: At 17th level, you gain the ability to set up lethal vibrations in someone’s body, effectively poisoning their implants with a kill switch you can activate at will. When you hit a creature with an unarmed strike, you can spend 3 CHI points to start these imperceptible vibrations, which last for a number of days equal to your brawler level. The vibrations are harmless unless you use your action to end them. When you use this action, the creature must make a Constitution saving throw. If it fails, it is reduced to 0 hit points. If it succeeds, it takes 10d10 entropic damage.

brawler:north-star::Bonus Proficiencies.text: When you choose this tradition at 3rd level, you gain proficiency in the Insight and Medicine skills, and you gain proficiency with first aid kits.

brawler:north-star::Aketsushuu (Healing.text: At 3rd level, your touch can mend wounds. As an action, you can spend 1 CHI point to touch a creature and restore a number of hit points equal to a roll of your Martial Arts die + your Wisdom modifier.

brawler:north-star::Dan Kotsukin (Cuttin.text: At 3rd level, you use your CHI to inflict wounds. When you hit a creature with an unarmed strike, you can spend 1 CHI point to deal extra entropic damage equal to one roll of your Martial Arts die + your Wisdom modifier. You can use this feature only once per turn.

brawler:north-star::Touki (Spirit).text: Starting at 6th level, you can administer even greater cures with a touch—and if you feel it’s necessary, you can use your knowledge to cause immense harm.

brawler:north-star::Hyakuretsu Ken (Hund.text: Starting at 11th level, you can now mete out a flurry of comfort and hurt. When you use Flurry Attack, you can now replace each of the unarmed strikes with a use of your Hands of Healing, without spending CHI points for the healing.

brawler:north-star::Tenha Kassatsu (Heav.text: By 17th level, your mastery of life energy opens the door to the ultimate mercy. As an action, you can touch the corpse of a creature that died within the past 24 hours and expend 5 ki points. The creature then returns to life, regaining a number of hit points equal to 4d10 + your Wisdom modifier. If the creature died while subject to any of the following conditions, it revives with them removed: Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, or Stunned.

brawler:otaku::Path of the Otaku.text: When you choose this tradition at 3rd level, your special martial arts training leads you to master the use of certain weapons. This path also includes instruction in the traditional and refined art of manga. You gain the following benefits:

brawler:otaku::One with the Blade.text: At 6th level, you extend your CHI implant’s energy into your otaku weapons, granting you the following benefits.

brawler:otaku::Study the Blade.text: At 11th level, you gain the ability to augment your weapons further with your CHI energy. As a bonus action, you can expend up to 3 CHI points to grant one otaku weapon you hold a bonus to attack and damage rolls when you attack with it. The bonus equals the number of CHI points you spent. This bonus lasts for 1 minute, until you drop the weapon, or until you use this feature again. This feature has no effect on a tech weapon that already has a bonus to attack and damage rolls.

brawler:otaku::Unerring Accuracy.text: At 17th level, your mastery of weapons grants you extraordinary accuracy. If you miss with an attack roll using an otaku weapon on your turn, you can reroll it. You can use this feature only once on each of your turns.

brawler:rave::Bonus Proficiencies.text: At 3rd level, you become proficient in the Performance skill and with one electronic musical instrument of your choice.

brawler:rave::Rainbow Blast.text: Starting when you choose this tradition at 3rd level, you can hurl searing bolts of multi-hued brilliance.

brawler:rave::Searing Blast.text: At 6th level, you gain the ability to channel your CHI into searing waves of energy. Immediately after you take the Attack action on your turn, you can spend 2 CHI points to cast the flame vent tech as a bonus action.

brawler:rave::Neon Plasma Burst.text: At 11th level, you gain the ability to create an orb of hardlight that erupts into a devastating explosion. As an action, you create the orb and hurl it at a point you choose within 150 feet, where it erupts into a sphere of radiant energy for a brief but deadly instant.

brawler:rave::Neon Shield.text: At 17th level, you become wreathed in a luminous, rainbow-colored aura. You shed bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet. You can extinguish or restore the light as a bonus action.

brawler:reaper::Reaper’s Call.text: Starting when you join this clan at 3rd level, your study of death allows you to extract vitality from another creature as it nears its demise. When you reduce a creature within 5 feet of you to 0 hit points, you gain temporary hit points equal to your Wisdom modifier + your brawler level (minimum of 1 temporary hit point).

brawler:reaper::Reaper’s Shadow.text: At 6th level, you gain the ability to unsettle or terrify those around you as an action. When you take this action, each creature within 30 feet of you that can see you must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be Frightened of you until the end of your next turn.

brawler:reaper::Reaper’s Friend.text: Beginning at 11th level, you use your familiarity with death to escape its grasp. When you are reduced to 0 hit points, you can expend 1 CHI point (no action required) to have 1 hit point instead.

brawler:reaper::Reaper’s Touch.text: Starting at 17th level, your touch can channel pure entropic force into a creature. As an action, you touch one creature within 5 feet of you, and you expend 1 to 10 CHI points. The target must make a Constitution saving throw, and it takes 2d10 entropic damage per CHI point spent on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

brawler:sunset::Touch of Darkness.text: Starting when you choose this tradition at 3rd level, you can use your CHI implant to duplicate the effects of certain techs. As an action, you can spend 2 CHI points to cast nightfall, nightvision, nanofog, or mute, without providing material components. Additionally, you gain the hardlight chicanery trick if you don't already know it.

brawler:sunset::Shadow Warp.text: At 6th level, you gain the ability to teleport short distances, but only while unobserved. When you are in dim light or darkness, as a bonus action you can teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see that is also in dim light or darkness. You then have advantage on the first melee attack you make before the end of the turn.

brawler:sunset::Shadow Cloak.text: By 11th level, you have learned to become one with the darkness. When you are in an area of dim light or darkness, you can use your action to become invisible. You remain invisible until you make an attack, cast a tech, or enter an area of bright light.

brawler:sunset::Opportunist.text: At 17th level, you can exploit a creature’s momentary distraction when it is hit by an attack. Whenever a creature within 5 feet of you is hit by an attack made by a creature other than you, you can use your reaction to make a melee attack against that creature.

brawler:surging-strike-old::Surge Discip.text: When you choose this tradition at 3rd level, you learn disciplines that harness the power of the four states of matter. A discipline requires you to spend CHI points each time you use it.
You can use your action to briefly control the state of matter within 30 feet of you, causing one of the following effects of your choice:

brawler:surging-strike::Initiate of Xplo.text: When you choose this clan at 3rd level, you learn how to manipulate the four elements in subtle ways. You learn two of the following tricks: pyrocache, aerogrid, geomesh, or hydroscript. You learn two additional tricks from this list at 6th level.

brawler:surging-strike::Surge Disciple.text: When you choose this clan at 3rd level, you learn disciplines that harness the power of the four states of matter. A discipline requires you to spend CHI points each time you use it. You learn two surge disciplines of your choice, which are detailed in the surge disciplines sections below. You learn two additional surge disciplines of your choice at 6th, 11th, and 17th level. Whenever you learn a new surge discipline, you can also replace one surge discipline that you already know with a different discipline.

brawler:surging-strike::Surge Discipline.text: You summon a long, rubbery whip of pure water that you grip by one end. You can spend 1 CHI point as a bonus action to create a whip of water that shoves and pulls a creature to unbalance it. A creature that you can see that is within 30 feet of you must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes bludgeoning damage equal to your Martial Arts die + your Wisdom modifier, plus an extra 1d10 bludgeoning damage for each additional CHI point you spend, and you can either knock it prone or pull it up to 25 feet closer to you. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage, and you don’t pull it or knock it prone. You can’t use Aqueous Manipulation and cast a tech during the same turn.

enforcer::Techno-Sense.text: The alluded presence of ramshackle digital constructs boils your blood. As an action, you can scan the area for such forces. Until the end of your next turn, you know the location of any A.I., virus, or hacked within 60 feet of you that is not behind total cover. You know the type (A.I., virus, or hacked) of any being whose presence you scan, but not its identity (the netsucker Anthe Féval-Schwartz, for instance). Within the same radius, you also detect the presence of any place or object that has been protected by safeguard tech.

enforcer::Healing Hands.text: You keep a swarm of replenishable medical nanobots in your wrist dispenser. You have a pool of healing power that replenishes when you take a long rest. With that pool, you can restore a total number of hit points equal to your enforcer level × 5.

enforcer::Fighting Style.text: Starting at 2nd level, you adopt a particular style of fighting as your specialty. Choose one of the following options. You can’t take a Fighting Style option more than once, even if you later get to choose again.

enforcer::Techcasting.text: By 2nd level, you have learned to draw on a limited but powerful suite of techs related to your principles of devotion.

enforcer::Neon Smite.text: Starting at 2nd level, when you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, you can expend one tech slot to deal neon damage to the target, in addition to the weapon’s damage. The extra damage is 2d8 for a 1st-level tech slot, plus 1d8 for each tech level higher than 1st, to a maximum of 5d8. The damage increases by 1d8 if the target is a Hacked or a Virus, to a maximum of 6d8.

enforcer::Nanotech Blood.text: By 3rd level, the healing nanobots flowing through you makes you immune to disease.

enforcer::Contract Clause.text: When you reach 3rd level, you decide upon the methods in which you will fulfill your contracts from henceforth. Up to this time you have been in a preparatory stage, learning the ropes of contract creation but without officially signing them. Your choice grants you features at 3rd level and again at 7th, 15th, and 20th level. Those features include contract techs and the clause perks feature.

enforcer::Harness Contractual Obligation.text: Also at 3rd level, you can expend a use of your clause perks to fuel your techs. As a bonus action, you remind yourself of your contractual obligations, and regain one expended tech slot, the level of which can be no higher than half your proficiency bonus (rounded up). The number of times you can use this feature is based on the level you’ve reached in this class: 3rd level, once; 7th level, twice; and 15th level, thrice. You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

enforcer::Ability Score Improvement.text: When you reach 4th level, and again at 8th, 12th, 16th, and 19th level, you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

enforcer::Extra Attack.text: Beginning at 5th level, you can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

enforcer::Get Thee Behind Me.text: Starting at 6th level, whenever you or a friendly creature within 10 feet of you must make a saving throw, the creature gains a bonus to the saving throw equal to your Charisma modifier (with a minimum bonus of +1). You must be conscious to grant this bonus.

enforcer::Keep it Steady.text: Starting at 10th level, you and friendly creatures within 10 feet of you can’t be frightened while you are conscious.

enforcer::Improved Neon Smite.text: By 11th level, you are so suffused with righteous might that all your melee weapon strikes carry the power of capitalism with them. Whenever you hit a creature with a melee weapon, the creature takes an extra 1d8 neon damage.

enforcer::Defragging Touch.text: Beginning at 14th level, you can use your action to end one tech on yourself or on one willing creature that you touch.

enforcer:anarchist::Clause Techs.text: You gain clause techs at the enforcer levels listed.

enforcer:anarchist::Clause Perks.text: When you take this clause at 3rd level, you gain the following clause perks.

enforcer:anarchist::Aura of Anarchy.text: After you reach seventh level in this clause, whenever a creature which is under the effect of your Get Thee Behind Me starts it's turn, or enters your Get Thee Behind Me radius, it may choose to forgo the bonus to saving throws to instead gain a bonus to melee weapon damage equal to your Charisma Modifier.

enforcer:anarchist::Too Free to Care.text: When you reach level 15 in this clause, you gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from mundane weapons. In addition, you also become resistant to entropic damage.

enforcer:anarchist::Angel of Anarchy.text: At 20th level, with a bonus action, your glee and excitement at the prospect of freedom creates a frightening aura that lasts for 1 minute. The aura reduces any bright light in a 30-foot radius around you to dim light. Whenever an enemy that is frightened by you starts its turn in the aura, it takes 4d10 software damage. Additionally, you and any creatures of your choosing in the aura are draped in deeper shadow. Creatures that rely on sight have disadvantage on attack rolls against creatures draped in this shadow. Your freedom is terrifying.

enforcer:ancestors::Clause Techs.text: You gain clause techs at the enforcer levels listed.

enforcer:ancestors::Clause Perks.text: When you take this clause at 3rd level, you gain the following two Clause Perks options.

enforcer:ancestors::Friendly Firewall.text: Beginning at 7th level, you’ve obtained a personalized anti-viral field generator. You and friendly creatures within 10 feet of you have resistance to damage from techs.

enforcer:ancestors::Hard as Nails.text: Starting at 15th level, when you are reduced to 0 hit points and are not killed outright, you can choose to drop to 1 hit point instead. Once you use this ability, you can’t use it again until you finish a long rest.

enforcer:ancestors::Commit to the Bit.text: At 20th level, your chosen emulation of the old action heroes has encapsulated your personality. You are now the Lone Swordsman, the Mysterious Stranger, the Robotic Policeman, the Hero of the Story. You’re a goddamn lunatic, but you get shit done.

enforcer:avenger::Clause Techs.text: You gain clause techs at the enforcer levels listed.

enforcer:avenger::Clause Perks.text: When you take this clause at 3rd level, you gain the following two Clause Perks options.

enforcer:avenger::Get Back Here, Asshole.text: By 7th level, your preternatural focus helps you close off a foe’s retreat. When you hit a creature with an opportunity attack, you can move up to half your speed immediately after the attack and as part of the same reaction. This movement doesn’t provoke opportunity attacks.

enforcer:avenger::Gloves Are Off, Prick.text: Starting at 15th level, the authority with which you speak your declared duel gives you greater power over your foe. When a creature under the effect of You and Me, Fuckface makes an attack, you can use your reaction to make a melee weapon attack against that creature if it is within range.

enforcer:avenger::Flying Bastard.text: At 20th level, can use the anti-grav function in your wrist augment to elevate your obnoxiousness to new heights. Using your action, you undergo a transformation. For 1 hour, you gain the following benefits:

enforcer:bodyguard::Tank the Shot.text: Starting at 7th level, when a creature within 5 feet of you takes damage, you can use your reaction to substitute your own health for that of the target creature, causing that creature not to take the damage. Instead, you take the damage. This damage to you can’t be reduced or prevented in any way.

enforcer:bodyguard::Shrug It Off.text: Starting at 15th level, you have advantage on saving throws to avoid becoming Paralyzed or Stunned.

enforcer:bodyguard::Glorious Golden God.text: At 20th level, your presence on the field of battle is an inspiration to those dedicated to your cause. You can use your action to gain the following benefits for 1 hour:

enforcer:disruptor::Bonus Proficiencies.text: When you choose this clause at 3rd level, you gain proficiency in the Tech skill if you don’t already have it.

enforcer:disruptor::Clause Techs.text: You gain clause techs at the enforcer levels listed.

enforcer:disruptor::Clause Perks.text: When you take this Clause at 3rd level, you gain the following two Clause Perks options.

enforcer:disruptor::Hostile Tech Firewal.text: Starting at 7th level, you create a field around you that weakens foreign, hostile techs while you're not Incapacitated. You and any creature of your choice within 10 feet of you gains advantage on all saving throws against techs.

enforcer:disruptor::Disabling Surge.text: Starting at 15th level, whenever you cast counter EMP or localized EMP, you may add your proficiency bonus on the ability check to defeat a tech of higher level.

enforcer:disruptor::Tech Eradicator.text: At 20th level, you can unleash the full brunt of your hostile tech firewall, making you a force to be reckoned against those who would use tech. You can use your action to gain the following benefits for 1 minute:

enforcer:drowned::Clause Perks.text: When you take this clause at 3rd level, you gain the following two clause perks.

enforcer:drowned::Aura of Storms.text: Starting at 7th level, you radiate an aura like that of a violent storm. While you’re not incapacitated, the area within 10 feet of you is considered difficult terrain for your enemies, and ranged attack rolls made against you or any allies within the aura are made at disadvantage.

enforcer:drowned::Wrath of the Seas.text: At 15th level, you can call on the force of crashing waters as a reaction whenever a creature moves into or out of your reach. The creature takes 1d12 bludgeoning damage and must succeed on a Strength saving throw against your spell save DC or have their speed reduced to 0 until the start of their next turn and be knocked prone.

enforcer:drowned::Fury of the Drowned.text: At 20th level, you can choose to fully let the water in, channeling the fury of the Drowned all throughout your body. As an action, you embrace these dark voices to gain the following benefits for 1 minute:

enforcer:icon::Clause Perks.text: When you take this Clause at 3rd level, you gain the following two Clause Perks options.

enforcer:icon::Aura of Handsomeness.text: At 7th level, you emanate an aura that fills you and your companions with incredible speed, allowing you to race across a battlefield in formation. Your walking speed increases by 10 feet. In addition, if you aren’t Incapacitated, the walking speed of any ally who starts their turn within 5 feet of you increases by 10 feet until the end of that turn.

enforcer:icon::Arousing Defense.text: When you reach 15th level, you can turn defense into a sudden strike. When you or another creature you can see within 10 feet of you is hit by an attack roll, you can use your reaction to grant a bonus to the target’s AC against that attack, potentially causing it to miss. The bonus equals your Charisma modifier (minimum of +l). If the attack misses, you can make one weapon attack against the attacker as part of this reaction, provided the attacker is within your weapon’s range.

enforcer:icon::Absolutely Stunning.text: At 20th level, you can empower yourself with the legends—whether true or exaggerated—of your great deeds. As a bonus action, you gain the following benefits for 1 minute:

enforcer:juicer::Generator Firewall.text: At 7th level, you constantly produce an electrostatic field around you and your allies. When a creature within 10 feet of you, including yourself, takes lightning or thunder damage, you can grant them resistance to that damage type as a reaction. If the target already has resistance to the triggering damage, the damage is reduced by an amount equal to your Enforcer level.

enforcer:juicer::Static Charge.text: Starting at 15th level, when you cast a tech that deals lightning or thunder damage, you can add your Charisma modifier to one damage roll of that tech.

enforcer:juicer::Magnetic Tempest.text: When you reach 20th level, you can supercharge any errant piece of metal like a dynamo, painting magnetic paths through local nanites as an action. For 1 minute, you have a magnetic field that extends 30 feet out from you, granting you the following benefits:

enforcer:loyal::Charming Presence.text: Starting at 7th level, you and friendly creatures within 10 feet of you can’t be charmed while you are conscious.

enforcer:loyal::Clean as a Whistle.text: Beginning at 15th level, you are always under the effects of the threat barrier tech.

enforcer:loyal::Neon Drenched Hero.text: At 20th level, as an action, you can emanate an aura of sunlight. For 1 minute, neon light shines from you in a 30-foot radius, and dim light shines 30 feet beyond that.

enforcer:peacekeeper::Clause Techs.text: You gain clause techs at the enforcer levels listed.

enforcer:peacekeeper::Clause Perks.text: When you take this Clause at 3rd level, you gain the following two Clause Perks options.

enforcer:peacekeeper::Politely Suggest O.text: Starting at 7th level, you can shield your allies from harm at the cost of your own health. When a creature within 10 feet of you takes damage, you can use your reaction to transfer that damage to yourself, instead of that creature taking it. This feature doesn’t transfer any other effects that might accompany the damage, and this damage can’t be reduced in any way.

enforcer:peacekeeper::Infused with Heali.text: Starting at 15th level, healing nanobots mend your wounds in combat. You regain hit points equal to 1d6 + half your enforcer level if you end your turn in combat with fewer than half of your hit points remaining and you aren’t Incapacitated.

enforcer:peacekeeper::Frighteningly Poli.text: At 20th level, you become a master of etiquette and dignified debate, clad in a wool cardigan and spectacles with a cup of tea always on hand, which gives you the following benefits.

enforcer:protector::Always Alert.text: At 7th level, you emit an aura of alertness while you aren’t incapacitated. When you and any creatures of your choice within 10 feet of you roll initiative, you all gain a bonus to initiative equal to your proficiency bonus.

enforcer:protector::Begone, Thot.text: At 15th level, you’ve learned how to chastise anyone who dares wield beguilements against you and your wards. Whenever you or a creature you can see within 30 feet of you succeeds on an Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma saving throw, you can use your reaction to deal 2d8 + your Charisma modifier kinetic damage to the creature that forced the saving throw.

enforcer:protector::Netscape Nullifier.text: At 20th level, you manifest a spark of neon power in defense of the real world. As a bonus action, you gain the following benefits for 1 minute:

enforcer:tyrant::How Dare You.text: Starting at 15th level, those who dare to strike you are psychically punished for their audacity. Whenever a creature hits you with an attack, that creature takes software damage equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of 1) if you’re not incapacitated.

enforcer:tyrant::Ultimate Badass.text: At 20th level, you gain the ability to harness extraordinary martial prowess. As an action, you can become the Ultimate Badass, gaining the following benefits for 1 minute:

influencer::Techcasting.text: You have learned various and sundry techs to improve the quality of your productions. Some of them are actually useful out in the real world too.

influencer::Influencer Inspiration.text: You can inspire others with your online schtick. To do so, you use a bonus action on your turn to choose one creature other than yourself within 60 feet of you who can hear you. That creature gains one Influencer Inspiration die, a d6.

influencer::Jack of All Trades.text: Starting at 2nd level, you can add half your proficiency bonus, rounded down, to any ability check you make that doesn't already include your proficiency bonus.

influencer::ASMR.text: Beginning at 2nd level, you can use soothing low-volume sounds to help revitalize your wounded allies during a short rest. If you or any friendly creatures who can hear your performance regain hit points at the end of the short rest by spending one or more Hit Dice, each of those creatures regains an extra 1d6 hit points.

influencer::Influencer Channel.text: At 3rd level, you start your own dedicated channel, or finally gain enough followers to start monetizing your existing one. While every influencer is unique, most of their channels can be divided into a few broad categories. This is actually important for an influencer who wants their productions to be found by a wider audience, since they have to self-label for purposes of metadata and algorithm-based searches. Influencers often seek one another out to cross-promote, or just to see what their rivals for clicks and likes are up to. This can lead to channel affiliations, where a group of influencers often stream together or lead “friendly raids” on each other’s streams. Your choice grants you features at 3rd level and again at 6th and 14th level.

influencer::Expertise.text: At 3rd level, choose two of your skill proficiencies. Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses either of the chosen proficiencies.

influencer::Ability Score Improvement.text: When you reach 4th level, and again at 8th, 12th, 16th, and 19th level, you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

influencer::Influencer Versatility.text: Whenever you reach a level in this class that grants the Ability Score Improvement feature, you can do one of the following, representing a change in focus as you use your skills and tech:

influencer::Always On.text: Your followers are always hungry for more content, so you learn to adopt your influencer persona at the drop of a hat. Beginning when you reach 5th level, you regain all of your expended uses of Influencer Inspiration when you finish a short or long rest.

influencer::Counter Influence.text: At 6th level, you gain the ability to use your influence to disrupt mind-influencing effects. When a creature within 30 feet of you would make a saving throw against being frightened or charmed, you can use your reaction and one of your uses of Influencer Inspiration to give it advantage on that saving throw. A creature must be able to hear you to gain this benefit. The performance ends early if you are incapacitated or silenced or if you voluntarily end it (no action required).

influencer::Tech Secrets.text: By 10th level, you have plundered technical knowledge from a wide spectrum of disciplines. Choose two techs from any classes, including this one. A tech you choose must be of a level you can cast, as shown on the Influencer table, or a trick.

influencer::Superior Inspiration.text: At 20th level, when you roll initiative and have no uses of Influencer Inspiration left, you regain one use.

influencer:activist::Bonus Proficiencies.text: When you join the Channel of the Activist at 3rd level, you gain proficiency with medium armor, shields, and military weapons.

influencer:activist::Combat Inspiration.text: Also at 3rd level, you learn to inspire others in battle. A creature that has an Influencer Inspiration die from you can roll that die and add the number rolled to a weapon damage roll it just made. Alternatively, when that creature is the target of an attack, it can use its reaction to roll the Influencer Inspiration die and add the number rolled to its AC against that attack, after seeing the roll but before knowing whether it hits or misses.

influencer:activist::Extra Attack.text: Starting at 6th level, you can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

influencer:activist::Combat Tech.text: At 14th level, you have mastered the art of using tech and weapons at the same time. When you use your action to cast an influencer tech, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action.

influencer:drama-queen::Insult to Injury.text: When you join the Channel of the Drama Queen at 3rd level, you've taken to reveling in the misfortune of others and always have something to add. Whenever you or an ally within 30 feet of you roll a 1 on the d20 for an attack roll, an ability check, or a saving throw, you can use your reaction to drop a sick burn and regain one expended use of your Influencer Inspiration feature.

influencer:drama-queen::Start Some Shit.text: Also at 3rd level, you've mastered the art of the cold read and digging up blackmail. When you or an ally you can see forces a creature to make a saving throw, you can expend one use of your Influencer Inspiration to change the type of saving throw to a Charisma save instead.

influencer:drama-queen::Gaslight, Gateke.text: At 6th level, you're great at getting your audience and even your allies to believe your side of the story, none that burn you will survive long. When a creature scores a critical hit against you or an ally within 60 feet of you that you can see, you can use your reaction and expend one use of your Influencer Inspiration to target the attacking creature and dig up some loosely related comment that looks terrible. For 1 minute or until the target suffers a critical hit, any weapon attack against the target scores a critical hit on a roll of 18-20.

influencer:drama-queen::Malewife, Manspl.text: Also at 6th level, your words can twist the affections and wants of others to over-promise to unachievable expectations. When you make an attack roll or a saving throw, you can gain a +10 bonus to the roll, but the next attack roll or saving throw you make takes a -10 penalty. If not used, this penalty disappears when you finish a short or long rest.

influencer:drama-queen::Apology Video.text: Upon reaching 14th level, you can touch a willing creature as an action and allow it absolute sincerity. For 1 minute, the creature is surrounded by somber backing vocals and black and white image filters, granting it the following benefits and drawbacks:

influencer:idol::Pulse-Pounding Performa.text: When you join the Channel of the Idol at 3rd level, you gain the ability to imbue your allies with vigor and speed.

influencer:idol::Enthralling Performance.text: Starting at 3rd level, you can charge your performance with seductive, captivating power.

influencer:idol::Majestic Performance.text: At 6th level, you gain the ability to project a forceful persona that makes others want to serve you. As a bonus action, you use the command prompt tech without expending a tech slot, and you take on an attitude of unearthly majesty for 1 minute or until your concentration ends (as if you were concentrating on a tech). During this time, you can cast command prompt as a bonus action on each of your turns, without expending a tech slot.

influencer:idol::Unbreakable Majesty.text: At 14th level, your appearance permanently gains a larger-than-life aspect that makes you look more lovely and fierce.

influencer:orator::Silver Tongue.text: Starting at 3rd level, you are a master at saying the right thing at the right time. When you make a Charisma (Persuasion) or Charisma (Deception) check, you can treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10.

influencer:orator::Unsettling Words.text: Also at 3rd level, you can spin words laced with subtle barbs that unsettle a creature and cause it to doubt itself. As a bonus action, you can expend one use of your Influencer Inspiration and choose one creature you can see within 60 feet of you. Roll the Influencer Inspiration die. The creature must subtract the number rolled from the next saving throw it makes before the start of your next turn.

influencer:orator::Unfailing Inspiration.text: At 6th level, your inspiring words are so persuasive that others feel driven to succeed. When a creature adds one of your Influencer Inspiration dice to its ability check, attack roll, or saving throw and the roll fails, the creature can keep the Influencer Inspiration die.

influencer:orator::Universal Translator.text: Also at 6th level, you gain the ability to make your speech intelligible to any creature. As an action, choose one or more creatures within 60 feet of you, up to a number equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of 1). The chosen creatures can understand you, regardless of the language you speak, for 1 hour, as your implants immediately translate your words and meaning into something intelligible to the targets.

influencer:orator::Infectious Inspiratio.text: At 14th level, when you successfully inspire someone, the power of your eloquence can now spread to someone else. When a creature within 60 feet of you adds one of your Influencer Inspiration dice to its ability check, attack roll, or saving throw and the roll succeeds, you can use your reaction to encourage a different creature (other than yourself) that can hear you within 60 feet of you, giving it an Influencer Inspiration die without expending any of your Influencer Inspiration uses.

influencer:personal-trainer::Bonus Profi.text: When you join the Channel of the Personal Trainer at 3rd level, you gain proficiency with medium armor and the Athletics skill. If you were previously trained in Athletics, you gain expertise in the Athletics skill.

influencer:personal-trainer::Fighting St.text: At 3rd level, you adopt a particular style of fighting as your specialty. Choose one of the following options. You can’t take a Fighting Style option more than once, even if you later get to choose again.

influencer:personal-trainer::Impressive.text: At 3rd level, you learn to conduct impressive displays of martial prowess and speed.

influencer:personal-trainer::Extra Attac.text: Starting at 6th level, you can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

influencer:personal-trainer::Masterful F.text: Starting at 14th level, whenever you use an Impressive Flourish option, you can roll a d6 and use it instead of expending a Influencer Inspiration die.

influencer:spiritualist::Guiding Whisper.text: At 3rd level, you can reach out to “the spirits” to guide you and others. You learn the hovering helping hand trick, which doesn’t count against the number of influencer tricks you know. For you, it has a range of 60 feet when you cast it.

influencer:spiritualist::Spiritual Focus.text: At 3rd level, you employ tools that aid you in channeling spirits, be they historical figures or fictional archetypes. You can use any sufficiently spooky object as a techcasting focus for your influencer techs, such as a weird book, a crystal ball, a tarot deck, or the like.

influencer:spiritualist::Creepy Pasta.text: At 3rd level, you can spin a spooky story that has just enough elements of the truth to leave people unnerved. While you are holding your Spiritual Focus, you can use a bonus action to expend one use of your Influencer Inspiration and roll on the Creepy Pasta table using your Influencer Inspiration die to determine the story your audience wants to hear. You retain the story in mind until you bestow the creepy pasta’s effect or you finish a short or long rest.

influencer:spiritualist::Spirit Session.text: At 6th level, your ability to interpret subtle informational cues provide you with seemingly supernatural insights. You can conduct an hour-long ritual “channeling spirits” (which can be done during a short or long rest) using your Spiritual Focus and browsing the internet. You can conduct the ritual with a number of willing creatures equal to your proficiency bonus (including yourself). At the end of the ritual, you temporarily learn one tech of your choice from any class.

influencer:spiritualist::Weird Tales.text: At 14th level, you now have the ability to nudge your audience toward certain spooky stories. Whenever you roll on the Creepy Pasta table, you can roll the die twice and choose which of the two effects to bestow. If you roll the same number on both dice, you can ignore the number and choose any effect on the table.

influencer:tagger::Disrupting Blades.text: When you join the Channel of the Tagger at 3rd level, you gain the ability to make your weapon attacks toxic to a creature’s mind.

influencer:tagger::Analog Horror.text: At 3rd level, you learn to perfectly time a sudden movement or ominous intonation to inspire terror in your listeners.

influencer:tagger::Adaptive Disguise.text: At 6th level, you gain the ability to adopt a humanoid’s persona. When a humanoid dies or becomes incapacitated within 30 feet of you, you can capture its digital essence (an “imago”) in your dump memory using your reaction. You retain this imago until you use it or you finish a long rest.

influencer:tagger::Deepest Lore.text: At 14th level, you gain the ability to tap into a creature’s most personal fears.

influencer:tech-geek::Hardlight Drone.text: When you join the Channel of the Tech Geek at 3rd level, whenever you give a creature a Influencer Inspiration die, you can summon a hardlight drone, which hovers within 5 feet of that creature. The drone is intangible and invulnerable, and it lasts until the Influencer Inspiration die is lost.

influencer:tech-geek::Box of Scraps.text: Also at 3rd level, as an action, you can use your hoarded junk to create one mundane item of your choice in an unoccupied space within reach. The item must appear on a surface or in a liquid that can support it. The monetary value of the item can’t be more than 2000 times your influencer level, and the item must be Medium or smaller. The created item falls apart after a number of hours equal to your proficiency bonus, becoming useless bits and bobs.

influencer:tech-geek::Nanite Infusion.text: By 6th level, as an action, you can target a Large or smaller mundane item you can see within 30 feet of you and infuse it with nanites, turning it into an animated construct under your control. The animate item uses the Nanite Construct stat block below, which uses your proficiency bonus, The item is friendly to you and your companions and obeys your commands. It remains animated for 1 hour, until it is reduced to 0 hit points, or until you die.

influencer:tech-geek::Maker Space.text: At 14th level, when you use your Box of Scraps feature, you can create more than one item at once. The number of items equals your Charisma modifier (minimum 2). If you create an item that would exceed that number, you choose which of the previously created items disappears. Only one of these items can be of the maximum size you can create; the rest must be Small or Tiny.

influencer:vlogger::Bonus Proficiencies.text: When you join the Channel of the Vlogger at 3rd level, you gain proficiency with three skills of your choice.

influencer:vlogger::Brilliance and Bulls.text: Also at 3rd level, you learn how to use your wit to distract, confuse, and otherwise sap the confidence and competence of others. When a creature that you can see within 60 feet of you makes an attack roll, an ability check, or a damage roll, you can use your reaction to expend one of your uses of Influencer Inspiration, rolling an Influencer Inspiration die and subtracting the number rolled from the creature’s roll. You can choose to use this feature after the creature makes its roll, but before the DM determines whether the attack roll or ability check succeeds or fails, or before the creature deals its damage. The creature is immune if it can’t hear you or if it’s immune to being charmed.

influencer:vlogger::Extra Tech.text: At 6th level, you learn two techs of your choice from any class. A tech you choose must be of a level you can cast, as shown on the Influencer table, or a trick. The chosen techs count as influencer techs for you but don’t count against the number of influencer techs you know.

influencer:vlogger::Peerless Skill.text: Starting at 14th level, when you make an ability check, you can expend one use of Influencer Inspiration. Roll an Influencer Inspiration die and add the number rolled to your ability check. You can choose to do so after you roll the die for the ability check, but before the DM tells you whether you succeed or fail.

mechanist::Techno-Tinkering.text: At 1st level, you learn how to integrate simple tech into regular objects. To use this ability, you must have locksmiths’ tools or technician’s tools in hand. You then touch a Tiny standard object as an action and give it one of the following technological properties of your choice:

mechanist::Techcasting.text: You have studied the basics of modern tech and how to conduct it through objects. As a result, you have gained the ability to cast tech. To observers, you don’t appear to be casting tech in a conventional way; you look as if you’re producing it using standard items or outlandish inventions.

mechanist::Tinker With Item.text: At 2nd level, you've gained the ability to imbue mundane items with certain technological infusions, turning those objects into high-end items.

mechanist::Mechanist Specialist.text: Mechanists pursue many disciplines. Here are specialist options you can choose from at 3rd level.

mechanist::The Right Tool for the Job.text: At 3rd level, you learn how to produce exactly the tool you need: with locksmiths’ tools or technician’s tools, you can create one set of technician’s tools in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of you. This creation requires 1 hour of uninterrupted work, which can coincide with a short or long rest. Though the product of tech, the tools are standard, and they disintegrate when you use this feature again.

mechanist::Ability Score Improvement.text: When you reach 4th level, 8th, 12th, 16th, and 19th level, you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

mechanist::Tool Expertise.text: Starting at 6th level, your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses your proficiency with a tool.

mechanist::Flash of Genius.text: Starting at 7th level, you gain the ability to come up with solutions under pressure. When you or another creature you can see within 30 feet of you makes an ability check or a saving throw, you can use your reaction to add your Intelligence modifier to the roll.

mechanist::High-End Item Adept.text: When you reach 10th level, you achieve a profound understanding of how to use and make high-end items:

mechanist::Tech-Storing Item.text: At 11th level, you learn how to store tech in an object. Whenever you finish a long rest, you can touch one civilian or military weapon or one item that you can use as a techcasting focus, and you store one tech in it, choosing a 1st- or 2nd-level tech from the Mechanist tech list that requires 1 action to cast (you needn’t have it prepared).

mechanist::High-End Item Savant.text: At 14th level, your skill with high-end items deepens more:

mechanist::High-End Item Master.text: Starting at 18th level, you can attune up to six high-end items at once.

mechanist::Symbiotic Technolink.text: At 20th level, the items you create are embedded with data relays that can assist you in a pinch.

mechanist:armorer::Tools of the Trade.text: When you adopt this specialization at 3rd level, you gain proficiency with heavy armor. You also gain proficiency with mechanic's kits. If you already have this tool proficiency, you gain proficiency with one other type of tradesperson's tools of your choice.

mechanist:armorer::Armorer Tech.text: You always have certain tech prepared after you reach particular levels in this class, as shown in the Armorer Tech table. These techs count as mechanist techs for you, but they don’t count against the number of mechanist techs you prepare.

mechanist:armorer::Custom Armor.text: Beginning at 3rd level, your technological pursuits have enabled you to integrate your internal systems into the armor you wear. As an action, you can turn a set of armor you are wearing into Custom Armor, provided you have mechanic's tools in hand.

mechanist:armorer::Armor Model.text: Beginning at 3rd level, you can make your Custom Armor in accordance with one of two patterns. When you do so, choose one of the following armor models: Guardian or Infiltrator. The model you choose gives you special benefits while you wear it.

mechanist:armorer::Extra Attack.text: Starting at 5th level, you can attack twice, rather than once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

mechanist:armorer::Armor Modifications.text: At 9th level, you learn how to use your mechanist widgets to specially modify your Custom Armor. That armor now counts as separate items for the purposes of your Tinker feature: armor (the chest piece), shoes, headpiece, and the armor’s special weapon. Each of those items can bear one of your widgets, and the gizmos transfer over if you change your armor’s model with the Armor Model feature. In addition, the maximum number of widgets you can have at once increases by 2, but those extra widgets must be part of your Custom Armor.

mechanist:armorer::Perfected Armor.text: At 15th level, your Custom Armor gains additional benefits based on its model, as shown below.

mechanist:biochemist::Tool Proficiency.text: When you adopt this specialization at 3rd level, you gain proficiency with microlabs. If you already have this proficiency, you gain proficiency with one other type of technician's tools of your choice.

mechanist:biochemist::Biochemist Tech.text: Starting at 3rd level, you always have certain techs prepared after you reach particular levels in this class, as shown in the Biochemist Techs table. These techs count as Mechanist techs for you, but they don’t count against the number of Mechanist techs you prepare.

mechanist:biochemist::Experimental Conco.text: Beginning at 3rd level, whenever you finish a long rest, you can produce an experimental concoction in an empty container you touch. Roll on the Experimental Concoction table for the concoction's effect, which is triggered when someone drinks the concoction. As an action, a creature can drink the concoction or administer it to an incapacitated creature.

mechanist:biochemist::Biochemical Reagen.text: Also at 3rd level, you learn to mix reagents on the fly. Once per turn when you damage a creature with a mechanist tech, or weapon affected by one of your infusions, you can deal additional damage of that weapon's type equal to 1d4 + your proficiency bonus and apply one of the effects below based on the number on the d4.

mechanist:biochemist::Biochemical Savant.text: At 5th level, you've developed masterful command of biochemicals, enhancing the healing and damage you create through them. Whenever you use a tech using your Microlab as the techcasting focus, you gain a bonus to one roll of the tech. That roll must restore hit points or be a damage roll that deals acid, fire, entropic, or poison damage, and the bonus equals your Intelligence modifier (minimum of +1).

mechanist:biochemist::Restorative Produc.text: Starting at 9th level, you can incorporate restorative reagents into some of your works:

mechanist:biochemist::Biochemical Master.text: By 15th level, you have been exposed to so many chemicals that they pose little risk to you, and you can use them to quickly end certain ailments:

mechanist:engineer::Tool Proficiency.text: When you adopt this specialization at 3rd level, you gain proficiency with electrician’s tools. If you already have this proficiency, you gain proficiency with one other type of technician’s tools of your choice.

mechanist:engineer::Engineer Techs.text: Starting at 3rd level, you always have certain tech prepared after you reach particular levels in this class, as shown in the Engineer Tech table. These techs count as mechanist techs for you, but they don’t count against the number of mechanist techs you prepare.

mechanist:engineer::Remote Turret.text: Also at 3rd level, you've learned how to create a remote turret. Using electrician’s tools or mechanic’s tools, you can take an action to magically create a Small or Tiny remote turret in an unoccupied space on a horizontal surface within 5 feet of you. A Small remote turret occupies its space, and a Tiny one can be held in one hand.

mechanist:engineer::Custom Firearm.text: At 5th level, you know how to integrate a dongle, cyberdeck, or crack into a custom firearm, a conduit for your destructive techs. When you finish a long rest, you can use electrician’s tools to integrate circuitry into a dongle, cyberdeck, or crack and thereby turn it into your custom firearm. This circuitry breaks if you later integrate it into a different item, but otherwise lasts indefinitely.

mechanist:engineer::Overcharged Turret.text: Starting at 9th level, every remote turret you create is more destructive:

mechanist:engineer::Fortified Position.text: By 15th level, you've become a master at forming well-defended emplacements using your turrets:

mechanist:field-mechanic::Tool Proficien.text: When you adopt this specialization at 3rd level, you gain proficiency with mechanic's tools. If you already have this proficiency, you gain proficiency with one other type of technician’s tools of your choice.

mechanist:field-mechanic::Field Mechanic.text: Starting at 3rd level, you always have certain tech prepared after you reach particular levels in this class, as shown in the Field Mechanic Techs table. These techs count as mechanist techs for you, but they don’t count against the number of mechanist techs you prepare.

mechanist:field-mechanic::Battle Ready.text: When you reach 3rd level, your combat training and your experiments with technology have paid off in two ways:

mechanist:field-mechanic::Auxiliary Defe.text: By 3rd level, your tinkering has borne you a faithful companion, an ADD. It is friendly to you and your companions, and it obeys your commands. See this creature’s game statistics in the ADD stat block, which uses your proficiency bonus (PB) in several places. You determine the droid’s appearance and whether it has two legs or four; your choice has no effect on its game statistics.

mechanist:field-mechanic::Extra Attack.text: Starting at 5th level, you can attack twice, rather than once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

mechanist:field-mechanic::Nanosurgeon Ca.text: At 9th level, you've learned how to program nanosurgeons to harm or heal. When either you hit a target with a tech weapon attack or your shield droid hits a target, you can release nanosurgeons to create one of the following effects:

mechanist:field-mechanic::Improved Droid.text: At 15th level, your Nanosurgeon Canisters and ADD become more powerful:

mechanist:infusions::Enhanced Tech Focus.text: Item: A crack, cyberdeck or dongle (requires installation)

mechanist:infusions::Enhanced Defense.text: Item: A suit of armor or a shield
